name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
description: Standard mutual NDA created by over 40 attorneys for technology vendors and procurement teams. Covers confidentiality, permitted disclosures, and governing law.

name: Cloud Service Agreement
description: Standard agreement for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products, covering subscription access, payment, indemnification, and confidentiality.

name: Design Partner Agreement
description: Standard agreement for early access product testing and structured feedback programs, covering IP ownership and program participation.

name: Service Level Agreement
description: Standard SLA designed to complement the Cloud Service Agreement, covering uptime targets, response time commitments, and service credits.

name: Professional Services Agreement
description: Standard agreement for technology vendors providing professional services via SOWs, covering deliverable IP assignment, subcontractors, and insurance.

name: Data Processing Agreement
description: Standard GDPR-compliant DPA covering processor/subprocessor relationships, standard contractual clauses, security incidents, and data deletion.

name: Software License Agreement
description: Standard on-premise software licensing agreement covering installation rights, updates, open source software handling, and warranty terms.

name: Partnership Agreement
description: Standard partnership agreement for business co-marketing relationships, covering trademark license, obligations, escalation procedures, and indemnification.

name: Pilot Agreement
description: Standard short-term product evaluation agreement allowing prospective customers to test a product before committing to a longer-term deal.

name: Business Associate Agreement
description: Standard HIPAA-compliant BAA governing use and disclosure of protected health information (PHI) between covered entities and business associates.

name: AI Addendum
description: Standard addendum for AI and machine learning product features, covering model training restrictions, output ownership, and AI-specific disclaimers.
